items.prompt: Edit this watercolor village game backdrop preserving EXACT viewpoint, layout, houses at top and edges, open hangar at top-right, river at left and broad central plaza. This is the START state, colorful playful welcoming BRAZILIAN village but visibly polluted and unsustainable. Keep coral/teal/yellow houses bright, handmade paper and watercolor navy ink. Central 50 percent plaza stays empty for game objects and protagonist. Foreground side pockets may show rubbish clusters. Buildings inviting, playful birds paper decorations allowed. NO people, no plane, no UI/text, no central game tokens or built upgrades. Keep high quality watercolor pigment, irregular ink, broad coherent warm lighting.

Transparent background all around, soft contact shadows only.
